objective: Minimize time to formal acceptance within CPU, memory and disk budgets while reducing duplicate artifacts.

storage.historicalRootsUse: preserved evidence only; never admit new Jenkins work

stageContract.executionLibrary: Scripted Pipeline with sealed-version workflow-cps load
stageContract.composition: validated dependency graph selected from change kind and required coverage
stageContract.skippedStageRequires: policy decision and evidence that its coverage is unnecessary or already accepted
stageContract.successRequires: verified receipt from the authoritative owner
stageContract.resumeRequires: same sealed input, stage implementation, command and coverage; otherwise invalidate affected descendants
stageContract.retries: stage-scoped and idempotent; reconcile prior attempt before resubmitting
stageContract.sideEffectsRequire: persisted session authorization and exact action scope
stageContract.reusedStateRequires: verified exact-result reference; current coverage and freshness policy remain mandatory

patch.title: 补丁
patch.receipt: owned after-content hashes and patch identity
patch.mutation: only owned patch; conflicting before-hash blocks and requests rebase

syntax.title: 语法校验
syntax.missingParser: blocked; never substitute an unrecorded build
syntax.validationMeaning: syntax only; type checking belongs to managed build

format.title: 格式校验
format.automaticFix: new owned patch invalidates affected receipts

build.title: 构建
build.receipt: managed build receipt, physical target, artifact digests and native termination proof
build.scope: selected packages, necessary targets/features and dependency closure
build.inputSource: immutable registered inputs in a stable new managed pool; no extra Git worktree

unit_test.title: 单元测试
unit_test.receipt: test filters, per-test result and exact tested artifact identity
unit_test.compilation: managed test compilation on demand; no unconditional duplicate cargo build
unit_test.executionResultReuseRequires: proven hermetic recipe with exact environment, coverage and validity policy

integration_test.title: 接口与集成测试
integration_test.receipt: affected boundary and consumer regression receipts

regression_test.title: 失败回归
regression_test.receipt: original failing regression and affected upward validation

acceptance.title: 验收
acceptance.receipt: formal acceptance bound to candidate and evidence
acceptance.nonCompileFlow: requires authoritative syntax/format/classification acceptance type; no fake compile receipt
acceptance.batchFlow: per-task author and union-tree dependency manifest; union success does not accept untested subsets
acceptance.historicalOwnerReference: existing source and managed validation authority

commit.title: Git 提交
commit.adapterRequirement: new independent commit implementation without implicit legacy notification hooks

notify.title: 推送消息
notify.receipt: durable outbox event and delivery receipt
notify.failureEffect: retry notification only; preserve acceptance and commit
notify.duplicatePolicy: reconcile ambiguous delivery before retry; do not promise exactly-once external delivery

gc.title: 产物缓存清理
gc.receipt: managed cleanup receipt and actual reclaimed bytes
gc.priority: below acceptance work; admission relief may run before build
gc.failureEffect: record maintenance failure without undoing accepted source

rollback.title: 失败回滚
rollback.receipt: owned compensation receipt and preserved foreign changes
rollback.preCommit: compensate owned files using before/after compare-and-swap; foreign or unproven hunk conflict blocks
rollback.postCommit: authorized forward revert reconciled against current HEAD

selection.commentsWithDoctestOrSemanticDirective: resolve affected test/build coverage; disallow comments_only
selection.unknownImpact: resolve coverage before scheduling expensive work; do not silently skip or run the full workspace
selection.manifestToolchainBuildScriptOrSharedRoot: derive affected dependency, profile and platform coverage; broader validation when required
selection.independentStageExecution: same identity, preconditions and authoritative receipt rules as a composed flow

coordination.singleCheckout: one shared development checkout; new local path-claim authority
coordination.conflictingPaths: serialize application and rebase on hash mismatch
coordination.sameSealedInput: one managed writer and consuming-task receipts
coordination.compatibleDistinctTasks: batch on one immutable validation view after author and coverage reconciliation
coordination.incompatibleTasks: queue by new validated compatibility and shared resource policy
coordination.independentModules: parallel only with distinct permitted pools or read-only test artifacts and shared CPU-memory budget
coordination.batchFailure: bounded failure localization; block dependent acceptance and compensate only owned failed work
coordination.gitIntegration: serialize final tree construction and recheck tested source against integrated tree
coordination.lockAuthority: new local state transactions and OS lifetime proof; Jenkins locks are optional projections
coordination.sharedExecutionJob: zircon-execution owned by executionId, independent of consumer flow cancellation
coordination.consumerCancellation: detach one consumer; cancel native execution only after all consumers release or an explicit execution abort
coordination.separateBatchCommits: validate each actual candidate/prefix tree; one union receipt is insufficient

artifactPolicy.exactResultIdentity: complete immutable source, toolchain, configuration, command and coverage
artifactPolicy.incrementalPoolIdentity: conservative PreparationKey toolchain/profile/target/dependency compatibility; source changes use Cargo invalidation
artifactPolicy.targetSelection: stable managed pools, not per-session or per-build directories
artifactPolicy.invalidation: recompile affected graph; preserve verified compatible dependencies
reducedSize: existing accepted development-link and profile policy
cold unreferenced intermediates retired through managed GC
artifactPolicy.incrementalTradeoff: retain hot incremental state; measure space and rebuild cost before retiring cold state

localResourcePolicy.priorityOwner: planned tools/jenkins/resources persistent fairness and aging
localResourcePolicy.fairness: reuse persisted weighted selection and aging; blocked starts do not consume priority state
localResourcePolicy.cpuBudget: cap simultaneous Cargo jobs and test threads using shared CPU-memory reservations
cleanupPreference: expired unreferenced duplicate inputs or results
cold intermediates with lowest measured rebuild cost
localResourcePolicy.historicalAdmissionOwnerReference: existing managed Cargo storage and CPU reservation services
placementCandidates: verified exact artifact or permitted stage result
new pool on another approved physical drive
bounded eligible cleanup followed by fresh re-admission
localResourcePolicy.placementSelection: lowest estimated acceptance time among fair and admissible candidates; not a fixed drive or strict cleanup order
localResourcePolicy.diskReservationAccounting: physical free bytes minus outstanding incremental reservations and safety margin; avoid counting existing bytes twice

failurePolicy.syntaxFormatBuildOrTestFailure: block dependent acceptance and commit; terminate attempt and invoke owned compensation policy
failurePolicy.foreignLaterEditsDuringRollback: block compensation and retain evidence; do not overwrite
failurePolicy.restartedControllerOrAgent: reconcile same attempt, native lifetime and receipts before resume
failurePolicy.cancellation: prove native terminal before releasing writers, CPU reservations or artifact leases
failurePolicy.commitFailedOrAmbiguous: reconcile candidate and HEAD before retry; never replay a blind Git commit
failurePolicy.notificationOrPostAcceptanceGcFailure: separate operational failure; no automatic source rollback

rollout: stage contracts and trusted change classification
comment-only authoritative acceptance and commit without notification side effects
module-unit composition on new managed execution and immutable inputs
same-input result reuse and compatible incremental pools
single-host CPU-disk-memory scheduling and lease-aware cleanup
multi-session batching, failure localization, compensation and restart reconciliation
acceptanceCases: comments-only creates no Cargo job and performs exactly the selected stages
doctest or semantic directive is never admitted as comments-only
overlapping patch ownership blocks without altering foreign files
same exact input has one writer and per-session acceptance attribution
changed source reuses compatible preparation without reusing stale terminal success
module tests build required artifacts without an unconditional second compile
disk pressure waits or selects approved roots and never admits stale/partial capacity
CPU pressure lowers admitted work without oversubscription or priority starvation
rollback preserves later foreign changes and proves attempt termination
commit-only does not send a message; notify failure does not repeat commit
GC cannot delete live writers, accepted references or unproven owners
no new Git worktree, per-session target or remote machine is created
cancelling one consumer flow does not kill a shared execution still needed by another

patchIntake.pipelinePreparation: apply owned patch and seal before registering the final build request
checks: Git HEAD and declared dependency hashes
patchIntake.conflicts: block without fuzz or guessed three-way resolution
patchIntake.partialFailure: block sealing and build; reconcile owned hashes before a new request
patchIntake.preparedDispatchWindow: retain source until the workflow dispatch is reconciled

pluginCapabilities.sharedExecutionSubmission: durable executionId plus authenticated parameterized API
